title: Settings Save Performance Optimization
instructions: Optimize the CMS settings save path to reduce database round-trips and connection overhead, targeting the 10-30 second save time on /admin/settings. Focus on changes within this repository: the CMS admin API and the KosDB client adapter. Document KosDB-server-side limitations that require changes in the external test.KosDB project.

1784451891.5425017.instruction: In webcms/admin/admin_api.py, refactor update_settings() so it loads all existing setting keys with a single SELECT before the write loop. For KosDB mode, run one query to get all setting_key values, build a set, then decide INSERT vs UPDATE per key without issuing a second SELECT per key. Keep the existing SQLAlchemy path unchanged except for any necessary consistency. Add inline comments explaining the optimization.

1784451891.5427217.instruction: In webcms/database/kosdb_client.py, add a transaction() context manager that acquires a single KosDBConnection from the pool, yields it for multiple query()/execute() calls, and releases it afterward. This avoids repeated pool acquire/release and ping overhead during a batch of operations. Ensure it handles reconnection if the connection dies inside the context and releases the connection in a finally block.

1784451891.5436406.instruction: Update webcms/admin/admin_api.py update_settings() to use the new KosDBClient.transaction() context manager for the entire KosDB write path. All SELECT/UPDATE/INSERT operations during a settings save should share one connection. Verify the context manager is used only when self.db is a KosDBClient instance.

1784451891.5437474.instruction: In webcms/database/kosdb_client.py, modify the pool's acquire logic to skip the ping() round-trip if the connection was used within the last few seconds (configurable, default 5). Add a last_used timestamp to KosDBConnection and a max_ping_interval config option. Log at debug level when ping is skipped.

1784451891.5438564.instruction: Create tests/benchmark/test_settings_save.py that measures the number of database round-trips and elapsed time for saving 15 settings via /api/v1/admin/settings. Use a mock KosDB client to count query/execute calls. Include assertions that the optimized code issues at most N+1 writes (1 SELECT + N writes) instead of 2N+1.

1784451891.5439565.instruction: Update SETTINGS_PERFORMANCE_ISSUES.md with a clear section distinguishing fixes done in this repository vs. fixes that require changes in the external test.KosDB project (UPSERT, BEGIN/COMMIT transactions, WriteBatch bulk writes, single-threaded write queue). Include recommended SQL syntax and file paths for the external project.
